Application Materials.content:
- There is **NO need to submit any hardcopy** of your application form or other relevant documents unless otherwise stated. This includes GRE/GMAT test reports.
- Once you have submitted your application, there will be **NO resubmission of any documents**, including GRE/GMAT test scores.
- Only documents uploaded via the GDA3 application portal will be used for admission review. The NUS MSBA admission team will disregard **ANY documents not submitted via the GDA3 application portal**; this includes emails and postal mails sent to the admission office.
- Ensure all required documents are uploaded before clicking “Submit”. Otherwise, your application will be deemed incomplete and will not be processed.
Document Checklist:
- Degree scroll / certificate / student status letter
- Transcripts / mark sheets
- Resume / CV
- Financial support documents
- National ID (NRIC / Passport)
- Passport-size photo
Application Essay:
- Personal statement on AI and Business Analytics
Optional Document:
- GRE/GMAT test score report
- Other documents as necessary
Scholarship Application Essay, if applicable:
- Personal statement for scholarship application
Academic documents:
- Please upload your official or officially certified copy of diploma/degree certificate and transcripts/mark sheets of your academic progress at each education institution attended to “Documents to Upload”.
- If you are pending graduation and unable to submit your degree certificate, please upload an official letter with university letterhead confirming your current student status.
- Unless academic records and diplomas are routinely issued in English by the institution, the official records in their original language must be submitted with an authorised translated English version.
- All official academic records should show the dates of enrolment, conferment, original title of degree, the subjects or courses taken, together with the units of credit allotted to each subject and, if available, rank. The records should also include a complete description of the institution's grading scale or other standard of evaluation.
Optional GRE/GMAT score report:
- Please upload your official score report by the testing institutions on the application portal. If you have 2 sets of scores, please upload the latest before the application closes. Test score will only be accepted if it is taken within the last 5 years.
- There will be no resubmission of GRE/GMAT test scores.
Resume/CV:
- Upload your latest resume/CV to “Supporting Documents”, including education backgrounds, work experiences, memberships, achievements, and international experiences.
- If you have a video personal statement you can include the link in your resume.
Referee report:
- This programme requires a **minimum of two (2) referee reports**. Please “Add Referee” to enter information of your referees. Your referees will receive an email with instructions on completing the Referee Report form and/or uploading the reference letter.
Supporting Documents:
- Personal Statement (optional) – You may add a personal statement highlighting your academic interests, professional qualifications, life experiences, etc.
- Personal CV.
- Financial Support Documents (bank statement, recent pay slip, sponsorship letter).
- National ID (copy of NRIC/Passport).
- Passport size photo.
Application Checklist:
- This section will indicate if further information or documents are required to be completed for assessment. Please note that the status of checklist may take 30–60 minutes to be updated.
- Ensure all required documents has “Received” status. Otherwise, your application will be deemed incomplete and will not be processed.
NUS Business School Supplementary Question(s):
- Application Essay (mandatory): A personal statement, written or video link submission. Please submit your response to the following question in a written essay in English (**no more than 350 words**) or **three-minute video** (highly preferred) or both. If you wish to submit a video, you can upload it on various video hosting sites, change the privacy settings to “Unlisted” and provide your video link in your CV/resume).
- Application Essay Question: “What is your point of view about the AI and Business Analytics trends in the industry of your interest? Describe what you have done, and what you plan to do in short-term and mid-term to ride on this trend. (**no more than 350 words**)”
- Scholarship Application, if applicable: You may indicate your intention to apply for NUS BAC Scholarship here and answer the following question in a written essay in English (**no more than 350 words**).
- Scholarship Question: “Can you share a specific project, initiative, or situation you’ve led in the past where your leadership directly contributed to a meaningful outcome or improvement? What was your role, what actions did you take, and what was the impact? (**Max 350 words**)”

Interview Requirements.content: Applications are assessed on a rolling basis, and interview or offer dates may vary.

Application Deadlines.content: Application for AY2026/2027 will be open from **6 October 2025 to 31 January 2026**. Check the [Application Checklist](https://msba.nus.edu.sg/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Application-Guide-for-MSBA-AY2026_27-11-Sep_v2.pdf) to ensure that you have all documents prepared. **Please note that your application will be considered complete only after the application fee has been paid.**

Academic Requirements.content:
- **A good Bachelors’ degree**, preferably from **Business, Computing, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Science or Statistics**, with a **good honours classification**; or **at least 2 years’ relevant work experience**.
- **Strong Mathematics foundation**.

GRE GMAT Requirements.content:
- (Highly Recommended) A good quantitative score in GRE/GMAT*
- *GRE/GMAT is highly recommended from AY2025/26 onwards.

English Proficiency Requirements.content: Applicants do not have to submit any English Language Test (e.g., IELTS/TOEFL).

Program Overview.content:
The NUS Master of Science in Business Analytics (MSBA) programme at the National University of Singapore is co-designed by NUS Business School and NUS Computing and offered through the Business Analytics Centre (BAC). BAC was established in 2013 as a collaborative effort between NUS and IBM and serves as the operational hub for the NUS MSBA programme, blending academic rigor with industrial prowess.
The programme prepares future leaders proficient in data science and business analytics to navigate digital transformation across sectors. It offers both full-time and part-time options: full-time students can complete the programme in approximately 14 months, with a maximum duration of 2 academic years; part-time students can complete it in approximately 26 months, with a maximum duration of 4 academic years.
The curriculum blends rigorous academic theory with practical, hands-on learning, preparing graduates to tackle real-world challenges in industries such as finance, information technology, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. NUS MSBA is supported by NUS Business School and NUS School of Computing, works closely with industry partners in developing new and relevant course content, and has a unique curriculum to nurture data-savvy business leaders and practitioners of data science.
BAC has a robust industry network with over 100 partners, including Accenture, Alibaba, Amazon, AXA, DBS, Ernst & Young, Google, Huawei, IBM, Johnson & Johnson, Morgan Stanley, SAP, State Street, Swiss Re, Ant Financial, Grab, Shopee, TigerGraph, and TikTok. These collaborations extend into educational initiatives and translational research. More than 1000 real-world industrial analytics and operations research (OR) projects have been completed by NUS MSBA students with partner corporations in the past 10 years. NUS MSBA partners with more than 100 companies in student education and career development, offers a unique industry-oriented learning experience, and provides 100% internship placements with partner companies for NUS MSBA students.
The programme was ranked Asia No. 1 and Top 10 worldwide in the 2024 QS Business Masters Rankings in Business Analytics. Since its inception, NUS MSBA has graduated about 900 alumni, forming a community of more than 900 alumni from 30 different nationalities/regions. Graduates emerge as skilled practitioners capable of employing data-driven strategies to solve complex business challenges in local and international markets.
The NUS BAC Advisory Board helps shape NUS MSBA’s strategic direction and ensures that its curriculum remains at the forefront of the business analytics field. Advisory Board members include Mr Ian Wilson, Chairman, NUS BAC Advisory Board; Mr Abraham Thomas, ASEAN Managing Partner, IBM Consulting; Dean Andrew K. Rose, Dean, NUS Business School; Dean Tulika Mitra, Dean, NUS Computing; Mr David Xie, Chief Executive Officer, Lark/Feishu; Mr Joe Chiu, Vice President, Changi Airport Group; Dr Matthew Wang, President, Cybernaut Investment Group; Mr Manik Saha, Managing Director, SAP Labs Singapore & Vietnam; Mr Sameer Gupta, Chief Analytics Officer, DBS; and Mr Shah Bhavesh, ConvaTec Group Global Vice President, Finance and Operational Excellence.
[Download NUS MSBA Brochure](https://msba.nus.edu.sg/brochure-download/)

Curriculum.content:
Students must complete:
- Units: **44**
- Courses: **8**
- Capstone Project: **1**
- Consist of **5 Essentials** and **3 Electives**
The Professional Consulting Capstone Course will be a year-long course in the form of capstone classes, industry analytics seminars, and a **3 – 6 month full-time^ capstone project**. ^Part-time students are recommended to do their capstone project with the company they are working for.
Essential Courses: Students will complete **5 essential courses** to build a cross-disciplinary foundation for Business Analytics and engage in rigorous study beyond the assumed disciplinary borders. This covers the interface between computer science, statistics, and other professional disciplines in the NUS Education framework.
- Analytics in Managerial Economics
- Data Management and Warehousing
- Operations Research and Analytics
- Foundations of Business Analytics
- Advanced Analytics and Machine Learning
Elective Courses (From 5 Verticals): In addition to essential courses, students are required to take **three elective courses from at most two** of the following vertical sectors. Students who aspire to be a Business Analytics expert in other vertical sectors beyond the five below may take relevant advanced courses from the respective participating faculties, subject to approval by the Academic Committee.
- Big Data Analytics Techniques: Big Data Analytics Technology; Cloud Computing; Neural Networks and Deep Learning
- Consumer Data Analytics: Hands-on with Business Analytics (Consumer); Introduction to Network Science & Analytics
- Financial & Risk Analytics: Fintech, Enabling Technologies and Analytics; Quantitative Risk Management
- Healthcare Analytics: Economic Methods in Healthcare Technology Assessment; Analytics For Better Health; Information Technology in Healthcare
- Statistical Modelling: Applied Regression Analysis; Survival Analysis; Deep Learning in Data Analytics
*This list is not exhaustive and subject to change.*

Financial Aid.content:
- **All Singaporeans and Singapore PRs will receive a 10% tuition fee rebate. All NUS alumni will receive a 20% tuition fee rebate.** Students may enjoy only one form of tuition fee rebate. The Tuition Fee Rebate described here is not stackable with other rebates, scholarships, corporate sponsorships or financial awards. Additionally, this rebate cannot be combined with any other rebates offered by any School, Faculty, College, Institute, or programme.
- NUS MSBA has a number of merit-based scholarships. Interested candidates may apply for these scholarships after completing their admission application. Only one scholarship may be awarded to each eligible candidate, and the scholarship cannot be combined with other rebates, scholarships, corporate sponsorships, or financial awards. Only fully completed applications with all required fields and supporting documents will be assessed. Only successful scholarship applicants will be notified, and scholarship outcomes will be communicated together with the admission offer. The scholarship application deadline for AY2026/2027 intake is **15 December 2025**.
- NUS BAC Merit Scholarship: open to **Singapore Citizens and Singapore Permanent Residents**. Each scholarship is valued at **S$30,000**. It is awarded based on merit, taking into consideration the candidate’s academic excellence, professional achievements, and leadership potential. Interested candidates may apply through the [GDA3](https://gradapp.nus.edu.sg/portal/app_manage) platform after completing their admission application.
- NUS BAC Global Scholarship: open to **international candidates**. Each scholarship is valued at **S$30,000**. It is awarded based on merit, taking into consideration the candidate’s academic excellence, professional achievements, and leadership potential. Interested candidates may apply through the [GDA3](https://gradapp.nus.edu.sg/portal/app_manage) platform after completing their admission application.
- NUS ASEAN Master’s Scholarship: an exclusive bond-free scholarship that covers full tuition fees for the normal candidature period of a Master’s Degree programme at NUS. The scholarship may be offered only to candidates who hold citizenship in Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Timor-Leste, the Philippines, Thailand or Vietnam; have completed an undergraduate semester at NUS under the DiscoverNUS scheme; have earned an undergraduate degree from one of the partner universities in their country; have been offered a place in one of the designated Master’s Degree programmes at NUS; and are not applying for a Semester 2 intake. A separate application is not necessary. For more details, click [here](https://masters.nus.edu.sg/scholarships-financial-assistance/detail/nus-asean-master-s-scholarship).
- Singapore Digital Scholarship (Postgraduate): an industry scholarship for individuals pursuing postgraduate studies in specialised tech or media-related areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Analytics, Quantum Technologies, Immersive Media, and Film Studies. More eligibility and application information is available [here](https://www.imda.gov.sg/how-we-can-help/singapore-digital-scholarship/postgraduate).
- Financial Training Scheme (FTS): provides financial support for programmes which aim to enhance the skills and capabilities of the Singapore financial sector workforce. Learn more [here](https://www.ibf.org.sg/home/for-individuals/skills-and-jobs-development/training-support/IBF-FTS).
- Institute of Banking Financial Standards Trading Scheme (IBF-STS): provides financial support for training and assessment programmes accredited under the IBF Standards. Learn more [here](https://www.ibf.org.sg/home/for-individuals/skills-and-jobs-development/training-support/IBF-STS).
- MOH Holdings (MOHH) Talent Scholarship Award: eligible applicants who are admitted to the MSBA programme and interested in Healthcare Data Analytics area are eligible to apply for MOHH Health Graduate Studies Award (HGSA). To find out more or apply, visit [here](https://www.healthcarescholarships.sg/scholarships/postgraduate/healthcare-graduate-studies-award).
- The Lee Kuan Yew Scholarship recognises outstanding individuals with the aptitude and inclination to contribute to society. Learn more [here](https://www.psc.gov.sg/scholarships/postgraduate-scholarships/lee-kuan-yew-scholarship).
- CIMB ASEAN Scholarship provides financial support, professional development and a mentor support system. CIMB welcomes applicants from a wide variety of academic disciplines such as Computer Science, Data Science and Psychology. To find out more, visit [here](https://www.cimb.com/en/careers/students/cimb-asean-scholarship.html).

Multiple Applications.content:
Information in the section (highlighted in red) will be pre-populated if you submit applications to another programme. In other words, you need not refill information in these sections in subsequent application(s) to other programmes.
Applicants should indicate if they have applied to any graduate programme(s) at NUS, regardless of the status/outcome, and provide details if they have previously applied to any graduate programme(s) at NUS.
If you have been offered admission to multiple programmes, please note that you can only accept one programme within the same intake.
